title.narrative: Improving quality, productivity and innovation for enhanced competitiveness of the Indian bicycle and bicycle parts industry (Bicycle project # phase 2)

description.narrative: For the Indian bicycle and parts industry to retain and improve its competitiveness, there is a requirement for the adoption of modern manufacturing processes, enhanced design competence, improved quality management and diversification into high-value consumer segments, including e-bikes, in line with global best practices and shifting market demands. Creating a market for testing and related advisory and training services is pivotal for this undertaking and requires simultaneous efforts to create a supply of such testing and related services (i.e., the quality support infrastructure) as well as their demand (by improving industry#s capability to use and benefit from testing and related services, in particular among micro, small and medium enterprises (MSMEs). Under the then UNIDO-DPIIT International Centre for Inclusive and Sustainable industrial Development (IC-ISID), UNIDO has implemented a project for the Indian bicycle industry, aimed at strengthening its global competitive position by facilitating technology transfer and capacity building interventions. This project, titled #Development and adoption of appropriate technologies for enhancing productivity of the Indian bicycle and bicycle parts sector# (SAP ID 160072; Jan 2017- Nov 2019), was implemented with the support of DPIIT, Government of India.
